itemList.description: Survey & Demarcation of Forest/ Block/ Compartment boundary including clearing of jungle growth to a width of 2 meters by engaging a gang of following persons. In area with thick under growth. 3 meters wide clearance Mazdoor requirement for 1 Km = 21 / 0.8 Km = 26.25.
Construction of labour shed using locally available forest material 10 unskilled heavy mazdoors(One shed for every 10 Kms)

Fixing the reference point / bench mark on the ground with reference to the map and surveying the tie lines for measuring the accuracy of the survey work done. @ 10% of  rate provided for Item No.101(a). (ii)  In areas with Thick under growth
Engaging one qualified Surveyor @ one manday for 0.80 Km of work.
Engaging one qualified Draughtsman @ one manday for 0.80 Km of work.

Purchase of Stationery like Tracing sheets, Graph sheets, Note Books, Files, Xeroxing, Scanning of Forests maps, Colour Printing of Maps, Auto Cad work of preparation of surveyed maps, Villages maps Preparation & per Village 05 Nos. Colour Xerox, Correction of maps, Typing of GPS readings & Annexure, Multiplication of records, Soft copy preparation etc.

Construction of Forest Boundary Demarcation Pillar of total height of 1.7 m (including Bed of 0.80m x 0.80m x 0.075m) having column of total height 1.0m with 0.35m x 0.35m at the bottom and 0.25m x 0.25m at the top (above footing), Pyramidal shaped Cap of height 0.05m and base of 0.25m x 0.25m, Footing of 0.5mx0.5mx0.525m Portion below ground and 0.5m x 0.5m x 0.05 m footing above the ground with the following specifications in Forest Boundary.
Scrutiny & Documentations charges and Miscellaneous Expenditure, etc.
